Name: AliveNpcs
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=5][b]🌿 AliveNpcs — An AI-Enhanced Village

[/b][/size][size=3]Make Stardew Valley truly immersive. Pellican Town and Every NPC lives, remembers, and reacts — powered AI.[/size]
[color=#f0c040][b]→ You need a free Google Gemini API key to use this mod ←[/b][/color][url=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey]Get your free key here → aistudio.google.com/apikey
[/url][b]YOU CAN ADD UP TO 20 FREE TIER API KEYS

[/b][/center]
─────────────────────────────────────────────
[center][size=4][b]🌐 Supported Languages
[/b][/size][/center]
[center]🇺🇸 English · 🇧🇷 Português · 🇪🇸 Español · 🇫🇷 Français · 🇩🇪 Deutsch · 🇮🇹 Italiano[/center]
[center][i]Other languages work great for NPC conversations — the mod UI is translated into the six listed above.
[/i][/center]
─────────────────────────────────────────────

[center][size=4][b]SERVER DISCORD: ﻿[url=https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852]https://discord.gg/8vUfXEH852[/url]﻿[/b][b]

⚙️ Installation[/b][/size][/center]
[left][spoiler]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Free Google Gemini API Key ([url=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey]get it here[/url])[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list][b]
Steps:

[/b]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download AliveNpcs and extract it into your [font=Courier New]Mods/[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Get your free API key at [url=https://aistudio.google.com/apikey]aistudio.google.com/apikey[/url].[/*]
[*]Launch the game and configure the key via the GMCM settings (gear icon on the title screen), or paste it directly in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[*]On your first day in-game, fill out your [b]Character Sheet(Press F7)[/b] when prompted — this dramatically improves the roleplay experience.
[/*]
[*][b]💡[/b][b] Tip — Get more daily quota for free:[/b]
[/*]
[*][list]
[*]AliveNpcs supports [b]up to 20 Gemini API keys[/b] and automatically rotates between them as each one hits its daily limit.[/*]
[*]Each Google account lets you create [b]10 free API keys[/b] (one per project). Use a few Google accounts to build a large key pool and never run out of quota.[/*]
[*]To add multiple keys, go to GMCM settings → increase the "Number of Keys" slider → paste each key in its slot.[/*]
[/list][b]Other tips:[/b]
[list]
[*]The mod comes pre-configured for the ideal experience. Play a few days before tweaking settings.[/*]
[*]Dialogue generation takes 1–3 seconds depending on your connection and chosen Gemini model.[/*]
[*]Saving the game may take a few extra seconds while data is written.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/spoiler][/left]
[*][center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
[center][size=4][b]About AliveNpcs[/b][/size][/center]
[center]AliveNpcs transforms the residents of Pelican Town into truly living characters. Every dialogue is generated fresh when you talk to an NPC — no more recycled lines. They remember your past conversations, gossip with each other behind your back, write you letters, and even develop emergent story arcs based on how you play.Every day in the valley tells a new story. And it's yours.[/center]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
[center][size=4][b]✨ Features[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][b]💬 Unique AI Dialogues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Dialogues generated on the spot — never the same line twice.[/*]
[*]NPCs consider your location, time of day, weather, season, local gossip, story arc progress, and shared memories.[/*]
[*]Free-text input: type anything and the NPC will react naturally.[/*]
[*]Multi-turn conversations: chat back and forth multiple times in the same day(change in configs, default is 1).[/*]
[*]NPCs will ask you personal questions about your tastes, opinions, and past.[/*]
[*]33 vanilla NPCs with unique personalities, fully faithful to the original lore. ﻿[b]plus: you can enable AliveNPCs with Stardew valley expanded and others custom npcs mods[/b]).[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]🎭 Personalities & Emotions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Daily mood system: weather, season, and specific events affect how each NPC feels.[/*]
[*]Emotional profile: NPCs gradually form an organic opinion of you over time.[/*]
[*]Emotional reactions (happy, sad, angry, loving, surprised) directly influence friendship hearts.[/*]
[*]NPC portraits change dynamically based on the emotion detected during the conversation.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]🧠 Memory & Relationships[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]NPCs remember past conversations and bring them up naturally.[/*]
[*]Character Sheet (F7): tell the game who you are and why you moved to the valley — massively boosts roleplay immersion.[/*]
[*]Friendship milestones: NPCs acknowledge when you reach 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 hearts.[/*]
[*]Gifts are remembered — NPCs know what you gave them and how it made them feel.[/*]
[*]Friendship level changes the tone of every conversation, from distant stranger to intimate friend.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]☕ Gossip & Village Life[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Your interactions become news — sociable NPCs spread the word around town.[/*]
[*]NPCs chat with each other daily (NPC↔NPC interactions), even without the player.[/*]
[*]Weekly village newspaper with headlines generated from real events in your save.[/*]
[*]Personal diary automatically tracking the story of your playthrough.[/*]
[*][b]"Keep a secret" button[/b] — so your flirting doesn't immediately become town gossip![/*]
[/list][size=3][b]🎬 Story Arcs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The mod detects patterns in your interactions and generates emergent narrative arcs — rivalries, romances, mysteries, and more.[/*]
[*]Arcs have hierarchical objectives and track your choices throughout the story.[/*]
[*]When an arc concludes, a new custom [b]Heart Event-style cutscene[/b] plays.[/*]
[*]After resolution, NPCs comment on what happened for days — involved NPCs give personal reactions, bystanders share what they heard.[/*]
[*]Resolved arcs become [b]canonical lore[/b], permanently influencing future conversations and gossip(yes, you can date Robin!(??)).[/*]
[*]You can replay concluded arc scenes from the Hub menu.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]📬 Letters[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]NPCs send you custom handwritten letters and gifts.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]🌍 World Awareness[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]NPCs know about marriages, the Community Center, your mine progress, and festivals.[/*]
[*]Weather, birthdays,  and in-game heart events directly influence daily dialogue.[/*]
[*]It's a small town — gossip spreads, and sociable NPCs will know everything.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]🖥️ Hub Menu & Settings[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Hub Menu (F9) with tabs for: Diary, Story Arcs, Letters, and Gossip.[/*]
[*]F7: Quick access to your Character Sheet.﻿[/*]
[*]F8: Read the Pellican town journal and gossips.[/*]
[*]Fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/*]
[*]Toggle any system on or off: gossip, NPC↔NPC interactions, weekly newspaper, arc conclusion scenes.[/*]
[*]Support for up to 20 Gemini API keys with automatic rotation when daily limits are hit.﻿[/*]
[/list][list]
Custom NPC Personality Sheets[*][list]
[*][b][b]Edit each NPC's personality, backstory, and secrets directly in-game. Perfect for players who want to live their own story, create custom roleplay scenarios, edit their custom NPCs Mods or completely reimagine how a character behaves.[/b][/b][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][center]﻿[/center]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
[center][size=4][b]🤝 Mod Compatibility[/b][/size][/center]
[spoiler][list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] — Fully compatible. AliveNpcs works with SVE NPCs out of the box (enable in settings).﻿﻿[/*]
[*][b]Other custom NPC mods[/b] — Experimental compatibility (works well, but the personalities might not be 100% faithful to the original yet. This has already been improved in several updates and will continue to get even better).[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
[center][size=4][b]🚀 Planned Features[/b][/size][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Relationship-based quests[/b] — Play matchmaker, stir up drama, or pursue romances the base game never allowed. Pelican Town's story is unwritten.[/*]
[*][b]Local AI model support[/b] — A version that runs without any external API, using a local language model on your own machine (requires a capable PC).[/*]
[/list][center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]
[center][size=4][b]💖 Support the Creator[/b][/size][/center]
[center]AliveNpcs is, and always will be, [b]100% free[/b]. No paywalls, no locked features — ever. This mod exists out of pure passion for Stardew Valley.[/center]
[center]If you're having fun and want to support my work (and help me pay the bus fare! 🚌), any contribution is incredibly appreciated:[/center]
[center][url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/]☕ Buy Me a Coffee[/url]🇧🇷 Brazilian users: [url=https://livepix.gg/gaticadev]LivePix → livepix.gg/gaticadev[/url][/center]
[/*]
